units.note: Numbers checked: 3 days' march, ~10,000 picked men, 4 days' provisions, ~80 Numidians, 30 stades ahead, ~120 stades: all match.

findings.quote: acting on the expectation fostered by the young men
findings.problem: Greek: κατὰ τὴν τῶν νεανίσκων πρόληψιν = in accordance with the young men's anticipation (they had foreseen and planned that he would spend the day in the Museum, cf. 8.25 ταύτην ἐτάξαντο τὴν ἡμέραν). The expectation is the young men's, not one fostered in Livius.
findings.proposed_fix: just as the young men had anticipated

units.note: The oracle's μετὰ τῶν πλειόνων (with the majority, i.e. the dead) is kept ambiguous in English; acceptable.
Numbers checked: cavalry not fewer than 2,000, ~1,000 Libyans, 4 men, ~30 Libyans: all match. Βαθείας rendered as a named place; not a sense error.
2,000 Celts in three bodies, two young men each: matches.
